money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The Liberian dollar is the official currency, however, the US dollar is accepted as legal tender. Liberia’s banking sector may experience cash shortages (of both US and Liberian dollars). Bring sufficient cash, in US dollars, to cover all expenses. Banks and foreign exchange facilities may be unable to pay out transferred funds or fulfil ATM withdrawals. ATMs are limited in Monrovia, and only allow cash withdrawals using a Visa card. laws.rule: It's a serious offence to have, use or traffic illegal drugs. Penalties can include large fines and long jail terms. Don't bring drugs into Liberia. - Carrying or using drugs
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: Same-sex relationships are illegal, with penalties up to one year in prison. - Advice for LGBTQIA+ travellers
laws.heading: LGBTQIA+ laws

laws.rule: It's illegal to: have pornographic material take photos around military and government buildings, airports, seaports, bridges and important government buildings export diamonds, unless you follow local export laws Penalties can be severe. Local prison conditions are harsh. - Staying within the law
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: You can drive in Liberia for up to 12 months with an International Driving Permit (IDP). You will also need to carry a police cover note in addition to your IDP. You must get your IDP before you leave Australia. After 12 months, you need a Liberian licence to drive.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Carry photo ID at all times (driving licence or passport copy). Drug, gold and diamond smuggling bring long prison terms. Same-sex sexual activity is illegal. Largely cash-based; cards are rarely accepted outside major hotels.
culture-and-protocol.note: From UK Government (FCDO) travel advice, written for British travellers but the laws apply to all visitors. Confirm locally.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: A visa is needed to travel to Liberia; contact the nearest Embassy or Consulate of Liberia. A yellow fever certificate must be shown on arrival.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Visa through a Liberian embassy or consulate (no online route confirmed on the pages read).
visa-preparation.before_departure: Arrange the visa through a Liberian mission and carry a yellow fever certificate. Land borders and ports can close with little notice.

steps.step: Contact the nearest Embassy or Consulate of Liberia for the visa.
Show a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate on arrival.
